1.1.95 update instructions (take a picture)

1. Settings > Map: off.
2. Set the range to 1.
3. Unplug the radar for 10 seconds and plug it in.
4. Settings > System > Check for update, then Install.

This may take a few attempts (repeat 3 and 4).

If it still fails, unplug 10 seconds, plug in, stay on 1.1.95. We will reach out with a solution.
